title: Coastal States Bank Announces Jason Dowdy as Commercial Real Estate Banker
summary: Coastal States Bank (“CSB”) has announced the addition of Jason Dowdy as Vice President, Commercial Real Estate Banker to its commercial real estate lending (“CRE”) team
body_markdown:
**ATLANTA** – Coastal States Bank (“CSB”) has announced the addition of Jason Dowdy as Vice President, Commercial Real Estate Banker to its commercial real estate lending (“CRE”) team.


Dowdy joins the bank with more than 15 years of experience in CRE lending, underwriting and portfolio management. In his role, he will focus on managing and developing client relationships to help business owners and investors with their CRE goals. Dowdy will specialize in financing solutions for real estate purchases and acquisitions, including owner-occupied and non-owner-occupied properties, new construction, and land and development projects.


“I am excited to have Jason join CSB,” said Will Rivenbark, Executive Vice President, Head of Commercial Real Estate Lending at CSB. “Jason’s deep understanding of commercial real estate and his commitment to building strong relationships will be valuable to our clients and our team as we continue to grow and develop relationships across our markets.”


Dowdy is a graduate of East Carolina University and is based in the bank’s Atlanta office.


**About Coastal States Bank**


Coastal States Bank builds relationships by providing a full range of banking services designed for businesses, their owners and individuals looking for a local banking partner. CSB has a community banking presence in the Lowcountry of South Carolina (Hilton Head Island, Bluffton, Beaufort and Charleston), Savannah and the Atlanta Metropolitan market, and serves communities across the country through its Government Guaranteed Lending, Senior Housing, Correspondent Marine and Mortgage Banker Finance lines of business. At present, CSB has approximately $2.4 billion in total assets.


CSB is a wholly-owned subsidiary of CoastalSouth Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE: COSO).


Coastal States Bank – Local. And Proud of It.®
